_comment: CF-001 (2026-10-30 audit). The Cloudflare account holds more Workers and Pages projects than this repo deploys, so they receive no secret rotation, no dependency updates and no review. This file is the committed inventory the drift check compares against. Every entry must be one of: tracked (a workflow in .github/workflows deploys it) or waived (a deliberate, reviewed exception with a reason). Adding a live resource means adding it here; the drift check fails until you do.
